title: Antibody Purification and Labeling
author: Maya Brewer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.667hhhn
materials: Antibodies should be in a buffer free of any amine-containing compounds (glycine, Tris, or ammonium ions) and stabilizing proteins (bovine serum albumin). These compounds will interfere with the labeling reaction.
Empty collection tube containing column buffer.

steps.title: Assess need for purification
steps.instruction: If the antibody contains BSA, azide, or glycine added by the manufacturer, purification is required; otherwise skip the purification steps.

steps.title: Assemble Amicon concentrator
steps.instruction: Carefully attach the Amicon Ultra device to the exchange device of the Amicon Pro Affinity Concentrator.

steps.title: Pre‑wet membrane
steps.instruction: Remove the collection tube cap, lift the exchange device cap, and add 1 mL of 1X PBS to moisten the cellulose membrane of the Amicon Ultra device.

steps.title: Initial spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the assembled device at 4000 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Load antibody
steps.instruction: Add the desired amount of antibody to the exchange device.

steps.title: Concentrate antibody
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4000 × g in a swinging‑bucket rotor.

steps.title: Wash membrane
steps.instruction: Perform two washes to remove residual buffer:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of PBS to the device and centrifuge at 4000 × g for 10 minutes; discard the flow‑through.
Repeat the addition of 1 mL PBS and centrifugation step a second time, discarding the flow‑through each time.

steps.title: Collect purified antibody by reverse spin
steps.instruction: Recover the antibody from the device using a reverse spin:

substeps.instruction: Place a collection tube on top of the Amicon Ultra‑0.5 device, ensuring the flow‑through has been removed from the bottom tube.
Centrifuge in a fixed‑angle rotor at 1000 × g for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Measure antibody concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the purified antibody concentration with a Nanodrop:

substeps.instruction: Make sure the sampling arm on the Nanodrop is up.
Using a P10 pipette, place 1 µL of the sample onto the lower measurement pedestal.
Lower the sampling arm and read the absorbance at 280 nm (A280).

steps.title: Determine labeling path
steps.instruction: If you are labeling ≤100 µg of antibody, stop here and follow the Antibody Labeling Kit protocol; if >100 µg, continue with the labeling steps.

steps.title: Prepare fluorophore solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve the amine‑reactive NHS‑ester fluorophore in DMSO or DMF at 10 mg/mL (e.g., add 100 µL DMSO per 1 mg compound), vortex to mix, aliquot into small Eppendorf tubes, and store at –80 °C if not used immediately.

steps.title: Verify antibody concentration
steps.instruction: Ensure the antibody concentration is at least 2 mg/mL (ideally 5–20 mg/mL) before labeling.

steps.title: Buffer antibody with bicarbonate
steps.instruction: Add sodium bicarbonate to the antibody to a final concentration of 0.1 M (e.g., 20 µL of 0.1 M sodium bicarbonate per 200 µg antibody) to create a slightly basic pH for conjugation.

steps.title: Add fluorophore to antibody
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of the chosen fluorophore NHS‑ester to each 200 µg of antibody.

steps.title: Incubate labeling reaction
steps.instruction: Wrap the reaction tube in foil and incubate at room temperature on a shaker for 60 minutes.

steps.title: Assemble purification column
steps.instruction: Prepare the spin column from the Antibody Conjugate Purification Kit:

substeps.instruction: Cut off the square tab at the bottom of the column.
Add both frits to the column and push them to the bottom using a stir rod or a P1000 pipette tip.
Use the yellow cap only when filling the column.

steps.title: Load purification resin
steps.instruction: Pack the column with resin:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of the resin suspension into the column and allow it to settle by gravity.
Continue adding suspension until the resin bed volume reaches approximately 1.5 mL.

steps.title: Pack column by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a collection tube, then place both in a 15 mL conical tube and centrifuge at 1100 × g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Load sample onto column
steps.instruction: Add the labeled antibody dropwise to the center of the column and allow the solution to absorb into the resin bed.

steps.title: Elute labeled antibody
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into an empty collection tube (inside a 15 mL conical tube) and centrifuge at 1100 × g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and store labeled antibody
steps.instruction: Collect the eluate (labeled antibody) from the collection tube, aliquot, store short‑term at 4 °C and long‑term at –20 °C.
